statements.status_notes: Debian fixed this for trixie in libevent 2.1.13-stable-1~deb13u1 (DSA-6493-1), which ships the upstream 2.1.13-stable point release, and the DHI build of that Debian version carries the fix. Upstream commit https://github.com/libevent/libevent/commit/e1f9e21887c6b104e206a718385ba3ffc75180cb bounds the decode loop in decode_tag_internal by the at most five bytes it pulled up, not by the full buffer length. Checked by inspecting the DHI Debian packages on amd64 and arm64 with their debug symbols. The disassembly of decode_tag_internal in the libevent-2.1 and libevent-extra-2.1 shared libraries matches the fixed code, with the loop bounded by the clamped pull-up length, and differs from builds without the fix, where the loop runs to the full buffer length. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-63383 and https://github.com/libevent/libevent/security/advisories/GHSA-fj29-64w6-73h6.
